era: Late-2019 IMDb (the 2019-12 title and find captures): full-width #121212 header with the yellow IMDb logo, Menu, the 'All' category search field with a search icon inside it, IMDbPro, Watchlist and plain 'Sign In'; below it the 1008px centred column on the #e3e2dd page, a dark #333 title block (title, rating, poster, trailer slate), a light #eee block with plot, Director/Writers/Stars and the blue #0e63be 'Add to Watchlist' button, white content sections and the late-2019 footer. The March-November 2019 captures show the older two-row header (Movies, TV & Showtimes / Celebs, Events & Photos / News & Community) over the same content design; the late-2019 header is used because it is the one the current markup can reproduce, and it is what users saw from late 2019.
